summary: Complete updated source code for CrediTrack featuring automated Google Drive auto-load of existing 'CrediTrack_Card_Manager' files and real-time background synchronization. On Gmail login, the app scans Google Drive, and if an existing spreadsheet is found, auto-loads all credit card configurations, tabs, and chronologically sorted transactions into dashboard context; only if not found does it create a new spreadsheet structure. Manual sync buttons have been completely eliminated from the UI in favor of seamless, real-time background API sync on every transaction addition, edit, deletion, or card configuration update.
